model.summary: Model favors CIN by 0.2 points (52% win chance). Biggest factors: Rest days (home minus away) (PIT +1.7), Offense EPA/play (recent-weighted) (PIT +0.8), Rushing offense EPA/play (recent-weighted) (PIT +0.6). The baseline of +1.9 covers typical home-field advantage.

total_model.summary: Model projects 51.5 total points (CIN 26, PIT 26). Biggest factors: Combined quarterback ratings (raises total 2.3), Combined offense EPA/play (last 8 games) (raises total 2.3), Combined offense EPA/play (recent-weighted) (lowers total 0.9). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.

qb_what_if.note: Approximate: swaps only the quarterback rating and the model's QB-change flag (a new starter counts as a change). Team offense and defense form stay as they are. A positive margin change favors the home team.
